landing.badge: The super simple assistant for West African entrepreneurs
landing.heroSubtitle: No need to love numbers. Snap your receipts, the app sorts your expenses, prepares your Burkina & UEMOA filings and handles the paperwork.
landing.noCard: No credit card • Fully compliant with local rules
landing.whySubtitle: A clear, calm app built for people who hate paperwork.
landing.why1Desc: The app watches your key dates and turns complex calculations into simple info (cash available, profit, spend).
landing.why2Desc: All your sales and purchases are filed per West African standards. Your accountant has nothing left to sort.
landing.why3Desc: Open the app and see straight away what you earned this month — visual, friendly, on phone or desktop.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need in one place
landing.featuresSubtitle: Simple tools that work together to run your business.
landing.featScanDesc: Just snap receipts and till slips. Libriwouô reads them, extracts VAT and files them securely.
landing.featCompliantDesc: Burkina Faso & UEMOA (SYSCOHADA) rules and calculations built in. One click to export data ready for e-SINTAX.
landing.featBankDesc: Import bank statements to reconcile. The app forecasts next month’s cash balance in advance.
landing.featStockDesc: Track items and tag products visually. Know where inventory goes and avoid stockouts or overstock.
landing.featTeamDesc: Add collaborators and generate ultra-clear payslips with state aids and local mutuals — no manual math.
landing.featSimDesc: Estimate future taxes in seconds. Get short, clear explainers on new tax laws that affect you.
landing.benefitsSubtitle: Concrete wins for your daily life as an entrepreneur.
landing.benefitTimeDesc: Spend 5× less time on admin. AI files everything so you can focus on customers and sales.
landing.benefitMoneyDesc: Avoid late fees and optimize taxes with clear explainers and simulations built for local trade.
landing.benefitPeaceDesc: No more tax panic. Your paper proofs are photo-archived, certified and ready for e-SINTAX or family filings.
landing.pricingSubtitle: Pick the plan that fits your business size.
landing.faqSubtitle: Everything you need to know to get started easily.
landing.faq1Q: I know nothing about accounting — can I use the app?
landing.faq1A: Absolutely. Libriwouô swaps expert jargon for everyday words: Income, Expenses, Profit. No technical entries to post yourself.
landing.faq2Q: Are calculations really compliant with Burkina Faso law?
landing.faq2A: Yes. The app handles taxes and filings for Burkina Faso & UEMOA (CME, RSI, etc.). All computed per current law so you stay safe.
landing.faq3Q: Is my data safe and private?
landing.faq3A: Absolutely. Your proofs and accounts are end-to-end encrypted at rest and in transit. Only you can access them.
landing.faq4Q: Can I try free with no commitment?
landing.faq4A: Yes. Creating an account gives you simulator and calendars straight away. Start gently, no fee.
landing.finalTitle: Run your business with peace of mind.
landing.finalSubtitle: Join entrepreneurs who ditched paperwork panic and tax stress for good.
